episodes.title: Capítulo 1: Los sueños
episodes.summary: Lidia is used to being a thief, but now she must steal in order to save her life. Different hopes propel each of the women into the workplace.

episodes.title: Capítulo 2: Los recuerdos
episodes.summary: Francisco offers Lidia a deal. Marga worries about what she saw at the party. Carlota's father interferes with her life.

episodes.title: Capítulo 3: Las mentiras
episodes.summary: The police are called in when Lidia's identity is questioned. Francisco's wife is suspicious and asks Carolina for help.

episodes.title: Capítulo 4: Los sentimientos
episodes.summary: Marga makes a lunch date with Pablo. Ángeles learns more about Mario's infidelity. Carlota's fantasies surprise her.

episodes.title: Capítulo 5: El pasado
episodes.summary: Carolina threatens to reveal who Lidia really is. Miguel tells Carlota she must decide about their relationship. Everything changes for Ángeles.

episodes.title: Capítulo 6: La familia
episodes.summary: Lidia helps Ángeles plan her escape. Carlota works to get Sara released from jail. Carlos fights with his father.

episodes.title: Capítulo 7: La pérdida
episodes.summary: The Cifuentes family mourns their loss. Lidia decides she should be honest with Carlos about her identity.

episodes.title: Capítulo 8: El amor
episodes.summary: The new rotary technology divides Lidia's loyalties, and she is forced to choose between Carlos and her friends.

episodes.title: Capítulo 9: La elección
episodes.summary: As 1928 turns into 1929, Lidia reports to a new boss, Carlota is blackmailed, Merga gets a hidden surprise, and all three rush to Angeles's rescue.

episodes.title: Capítulo 10: El pacto
episodes.summary: Lidia directs a cover-up plan, but a theft complicates things and Marga is later caught in a lie. Carlos and Francisco negotiate an alliance.

episodes.title: Capítulo 11: Los celos
episodes.summary: Marisol tries to drive Marga and Pablo apart. Carlota becomes suspicious of Sara. Lidia notices a crucial difference between Carlos and Francisco.

episodes.title: Capítulo 12: La culpa
episodes.summary: Sara reveals a secret to Carlota. Ángeles learns Inspector Cuevas's weakness. Pablo shows Marga his undying love. Lidia helps end an operator strike.

episodes.title: Capítulo 13: Los secretos
episodes.summary: Sara seeks medical advice. Lidia gets news that complicates her choice between Francisco and Carlos. Marga learns Pablo is hiding a delicate problem.

episodes.title: Capítulo 14: La soledad
episodes.summary: Lidia gets a tempting offer. Carlota and her friends respond to a plea for help. Ángeles takes a risky step in order to learn the witness's identity.

episodes.title: Capítulo 15: Las oportunidades
episodes.summary: The police find a body. Ángeles learns who's been spooking her. Francisco gives Lidia space, while Carlos gives her a surprise. An arrest is made.

episodes.title: Capítulo 16: La inocencia
episodes.summary: Carlota gets news about Miguel. Guilt-stricken Marga goes into seclusion. Lidia learns Francisco has made a decision. Ángeles finds herself cornered.

episodes.title: Capítulo 17: El tiempo
episodes.summary: Six months later, a catastrophic event deeply affects Lidia, Marga, Carlota, Ángeles and their loved ones. Marga gets a surprise visit from an in-law.

episodes.title: Capítulo 18: La muerte
episodes.summary: With her friends' help, Lidia puts her plan into action. Carlota decides what to do with her inheritance. Ángeles tries to earn Pedro Guzmán's trust.

episodes.title: Capítulo 19: La verdad
episodes.summary: Lidia's desperation worries Carlos and spurs Francisco to offer support. Marga helps Julio cover Pablo's job. Carlota finds a way to promote her cause.

episodes.title: Capítulo 20: La venganza
episodes.summary: Lidia and Francisco visit an orphanage to gather info. Complications arise with Marga when Julio impersonates housebound Pablo, who sneaks back to work.

episodes.title: Capítulo 21: El pecado
episodes.summary: Ángeles must deflect Guzmán's suspicion of a mole. Carlos learns his mother's car was sabotaged and confronts Lidia. Marga has a horrible realization

episodes.title: Capítulo 22: La lucha
episodes.summary: To protect her child, Ángeles accepts a deal with Guzmán. A phone call gives Lidia a hunch on Eva's whereabouts. Carlota responds to her attackers.

episodes.title: Capítulo 23: La esperanza
episodes.summary: Lidia turns the tables on her captor. During the king's visit, those fighting for Carlota's cause take drastic measures, forcing her to choose sides.

episodes.title: Capítulo 24: El destino
episodes.summary: As the situation escalates, Lidia tries to get to Eva, Marga shocks Pablo, Carlota takes a risk, Ángeles learns a truth and Francisco attempts a rescue.

episodes.title: Capítulo 25: La igualdad
episodes.summary: Carlota's new political career faces a major obstacle as Marga suffers heartbreak. Meanwhile, Lidia returns to work and Ángeles pitches an idea to her.

episodes.title: Capítulo 26: La libertad
episodes.summary: As her memory starts to slowly come back, Carlota's friends try to clear her name. Ángeles begins teaching classes. Lidia's former enemy returns.

episodes.title: Capítulo 27: La justicia
episodes.summary: Lidia and Carlos argue over a loved one's medical treatment. Óscar makes a shocking discovery about Dulce. Marga gets to know her boss better.

episodes.title: Capítulo 28: El miedo
episodes.summary: With Carlota's future looking perilous, Óscar starts falsifying evidence to get her out of prison. A different doctor gives Lidia new hope.

episodes.title: Capítulo 29: La vida
episodes.summary: The friends begin concocting a plan to free Óscar from prison and Marga turns to Pablo for assistance. Carlos is surprised by his friend's condition.

episodes.title: Capítulo 30: La duda
episodes.summary: Carmen creates a deception while Carlos continues to keep Lidia in the dark. Carlota tries desperately to escape from her captor.

episodes.title: Capítulo 31: La felicidad
episodes.summary: Lidia is confused and hurt by Carlos's betrayal. An unlikely ally is enlisted to try to free Óscar. Carmen's calculating plan starts falling into place.

episodes.title: Capítulo 32: La suerte
episodes.summary: When the prison break is set in motion, the team faces unforeseen consequences. Lidia makes a heartbreaking decision in order to protect Eva.

episodes.title: Capítulo 33: La guerra
episodes.summary: Lidia leaves New York and returns to Madrid in search of Sofía, who has run away to join the Republicans in the Spanish Civil War.

episodes.title: Capítulo 34: El odio
episodes.summary: Lidia's friends — both old and new — help her attempt to force Carlos to call Sofía back from the front lines. Pablo looks for ways to avoid enlisting.

episodes.title: Capítulo 35: El valor
episodes.summary: Óscar and Carlota risk their journalistic integrity in exchange for helping Lidia with Sofía. Marga falls ill while running a dangerous errand.

episodes.title: Capítulo 36: El control
episodes.summary: Carlos and Lidia encounter trouble in their search for Sofía. Carlota visits the western front with James, to Óscar's chagrin. Pablo goes missing.

episodes.title: Capítulo 37: La locura
episodes.summary: When Madrid falls to the Nationalists, Lidia and most of her friends must face widespread grief and devastation, with long-term consequences.

episodes.title: Capítulo 38: El poder
episodes.summary: Lidia's defiance gets her into trouble at the prison camp, while Francisco concocts a plan to free her. Marga confides her secrets to Isidro.

episodes.title: Capítulo 39: La paciencia
episodes.summary: Lidia is desperate to save her imprisoned friend. Elisa discloses Carlos' fate. Marga realizes who betrayed her. Carmen targets Lidia's loved ones.

episodes.title: Capítulo 40: El dolor
episodes.summary: Elisa reveals a startling secret as more of Lidia's friends are endangered. Sofía turns to an old friend for help protecting the prisoners from Carmen.

episodes.title: Capítulo 41: La derrota
episodes.summary: An unexpected ally seeking the ultimate revenge helps Lidia try and enact her plan to free all the prisoners from the women's prison camp.

episodes.title: Capítulo 42: El final
episodes.summary: When the final phase of their escape plan is threatened, Lidia, Carlota, Marga and Óscar make a momentous decision together.
